test_purpose: VCST-5546 stock-per-fulfillment-center lists VARIATIONS, not only masters - INV-047
notes: A real variation SKU (a child product carrying mainProductId = the masters id), NOT a standalone product, with NON-ZERO stock at the STORES MAIN fulfillment center. Seeded by scripts/seed-data/inventory/seed-variation-stock.mjs. The two stock quantities are deliberately DIFFERENT (master 7 / variation 42) so INV-047 can prove the per-FFC grid shows the variations OWN inventory record rather than a master aggregate - equal quantities would make that assertion unfalsifiable. The FFC is resolved LIVE via seed-common storeMainFulfillmentCenter() (the fulfillment-centers.csv store_role=main row, FFC-001 / FC_EAST), never ffcs[0]; its runtime GUID is written to aliases.<env>.json for BOTH this fixture and FC_EAST, so @td(FC_EAST.id) stops resolving to the bare business key. No variation URL is published: a variation has no independent PDP route on this storefront (it renders on the masters PDP), and inventing one would be a fabricated route - navigate @td(INV_VARIATION_MASTER.url) instead. master_id / variation_id / ffc_id are runtime GUIDs and MUST stay blank here.
